race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: Improving 3-y-o FAHIDI gets the vote having pulled clear with a subsequent winner at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. Almekarem isn't the easiest of rides but there's no doubt he has the ability to win off his current mark, while Charlie's Choice is another who's more than capable with his yard hitting form. FAHIDI (IRE) ALMEKAREM (IRE) CHARLIE'S CHOICE
